limitations: Three repeats support descriptive medians and ranges, not a strong inferential performance claim.
The executors deliberately use different task topologies: Craftmake emits three logical worker jobs while the Snakemake compatibility projection emits one worker job.
Queue time is reported separately and should not be attributed to executor implementation.
This study does not include a topology-identical microbenchmark or cancellation/recovery repetitions.

balanced_order.bs-pdx: Craftmake first twice and Snakemake first once
balanced_order.rna-pdx: Snakemake first twice and Craftmake first once

fixed_dimensions: Xenofilx worker resource envelope 4 CPU and 16G
